command:
set -e; BASE=http://192.168.0.16; sleep 5; curl -fsS --max-time 8 "$BASE/rpc/Script.GetStatus?id=1" -o /tmp/lcl-script-status-2.json; curl -fsS --max-time 8 "$BASE/rpc/Switch.GetStatus?id=0" -o /tmp/lcl-switch-2.json; curl -fsS --max-time 8 "$BASE/script/1/diag" -o /tmp/lcl-diag-2.json; python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
status=json.loads(Path('/tmp/lcl-script-status-2.json').read_text())
switch=json.loads(Path('/tmp/lcl-switch-2.json').read_text())
diag=json.loads(Path('/tmp/lcl-diag-2.json').read_text())
assert status.get('running') is True, status
assert switch.get('output') is False, switch
assert isinstance(diag, dict) and diag, diag
print('shelly_runtime_recheck=pass')
print('shelly_relay_final=false')
PY
